messages:
anna_cs: Escalation from Acme (cust_9821). They signed up via SSO and ended up with two workspaces. Trial grant ($500) landed on the duplicate workspace (ws-7a9c, label 'acme-staging') instead of the prod workspace (ws-1c4b, 'acme-prod'). Customer can't apply the credit to their production routes — ticket CS-6721 attached.

anna_cs: Quick repro and logs below:
```
[2026-03-15T09:12:03Z] org-provisioner-bot: create_workspace org=org-77 ws=ws-7a9c actor=alice@acme.com method=SCIM
[2026-03-15T09:12:04Z] billing-service: apply_promo promo_id=trial-2026 applied_to=ws-7a9c amount=500 actor=system
```

anna_cs: Steps to reproduce: 1) SSO SCIM provisioning for new user 2) provisioning creates a second workspace (name collisions) 3) system promo hook applies to the newly-created workspace automatically.

matt_platform: I ran an audit query against internal ledger for cust_9821 — two rows found, both $500 events but attached to different workspace_ids. Looks like promo hook uses the most-recently-created workspace for that org.

matt_platform: Query I used: ```sql
SELECT id, workspace_id, amount, created_at, source FROM credits WHERE customer_id='cust_9821' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10;
```

devin_billing: Thanks for the details. We can move the credit manually but need explicit customer consent (PII/billing rule). Do we have that on the ticket?

zoe_support: Customer (Alice) replied in CS thread: "Yes, please move the $500 to acme-prod (ws-1c4b). I confirm I authorize Redwood to reassign the trial credit." — timestamped 2026-03-15 09:28 UTC.

devin_billing: OK proceeding. Internal move command (billing-admin):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://internal.billing.redwood/v1/admin/transfer_credit" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \ 
  -d '{"from_workspace":"ws-7a9c","to_workspace":"ws-1c4b","amount":500,"reason":"duplicate-workspace-sso-misapply","ticket":"CS-6721"}'
```

devin_billing: Completed transfer at 2026-03-15T09:30:08Z — transaction id tx-99412. I updated ledger entries and created an adjustment note.

matt_platform: Added a short-term safety check to the promo hook to prefer existing workspace with active API keys; filed a follow-up engineering task ENG-2209 to make promo assignment deterministic for SCIM flows.

anna_cs: Notified customer that credits moved and asked them to verify. They confirmed the credit is visible in acme-prod and applied to a test call. :white_check_mark:

anna_cs: Closing CS-6721 after follow-up. Thanks everyone!
